pages.text: Terramity adds atmospheric world generation features — terrain details, cave enhancements, and environmental variety throughout the Overworld.

$(bold)Role in the pack:$() Background world enrichment. Terramity works passively — its additions appear naturally as you explore. No active systems to manage.$(br2)$(bold)Exploration tip:$() Terramity features appear in all biomes but are most visible in caves and cliff faces. Keep an eye out for new stone formations and cave decorations.

Craft the $(bold)Terramity Guidebook$() for the full reference — all added features, biome interactions, and configuration notes.$(br2)Given on first join via the Terramity advancement. Right-click in hand to open. If lost, /give yourself the Terramity Guidebook Icon.
